summary: This recipe aggregates neuron centroids from multiple zebrafish larvae into a unified 3D brain atlas coordinate system, grouped by functional response categories: motor-correlated, motor-anticorrelated, dark-responsive, and light-responsive.
use_when: Analyze zebrafish neuron spatial distribution in 3d atlas coordinates
Generate zebrafish neuron spatial distribution in 3d atlas coordinates outputs
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
Independent biological replicates or an appropriate null model are unavailable
